text:
maria: quick heads-up before tomorrow's change window (EU 06:00 UTC). i'm taking a preflight SLO snapshot and want to lock the gate metrics.
jon: gate list: p95 per-route, p99 embed, 5xx rate, error-budget burn, kv-cache miss%, kernel-fallback count, reranker 4xx.
lee: add model-variant fallback rate and orchestration queue depth for gpu nodes. we saw queue spikes last week.
sre-bot: simulated alert: embed-route p95 +28% vs baseline in last 35m (baseline 110ms -> 141ms). trace id trace-eu-a7f.
maria: did staging take rc3?
jon: yes, quantize-v2.1.4-rc3 went to staging at 02:50 UTC. no prod changes.
lee: pulled trace logs: kernel fallback events on gpu-04 correlating with higher KV fetch times; a few 502 tails.
maria: recommendation: place EU embed route on hold for the window and pin to v2.1.4-rc2. we should run kernel regressions overnight on rc3.
jon: agree. record pin and update release notes: "EU change window: hold traffic shift; eu-embed pinned to v2.1.4-rc2 pending kernel regression on rc3 (see RED-4219)."
deploy-bot: pin recorded by @maria -> route=eu-embed, version=v2.1.4-rc2, reason="staging p95 rise with rc3 kernel fallbacks". ticket RED-4219 created.
sre-bot: smoke test on pinned v2.1.4-rc2: sample 2k -> p95=113ms, 5xx=0.06%, kv-miss=1.8% -> OK.
lee: action items: 1) update release notes & changelog with pin + unpin commands; 2) run kernel regression matrix on rc3 overnight; 3) re-eval at 04:30 UTC, final go/no-go at 05:00 UTC.
maria: abort criteria: p95 > 1.25x baseline OR 5xx > 0.5% OR kernel-fallback-rate > 2x baseline. ramp plan if green: 10% -> 30% -> 60%.
jon: i'll post runbook snippet and trace ids to RED-4219. include quick unpin: `deploy-bot pin remove --route eu-embed --version v2.1.4-rc2`.
sre-bot: tagging oncall: @jon @lee ack and monitor overnight runs. final snapshot will be posted at 04:30 UTC.
jon: ack.
lee: ack. :thumbsup:
maria: thanks team — merging hold note into release notes PR and will update after regression results. (END)
